parsed.rationale: The rhythm is regular with visible P waves and a narrow QRS. V1–V3 show very deep S waves and V5–V6 show tall R waves, which is voltage-criteria LVH. V6 has lateral ST depression and T inversion (strain). The ST elevation in V1–V3 is discordant to the deep S waves, a repolarization pattern seen with LVH, so it does not meet STEMI criteria.
